inputs.name: input
inputs.source_document: QNN runtime-reported ABI, QCS6490 HTP board probe 2026-09-15

notes.source: Camera FW RAW is NV12 / BT.709 limited; the model tensor is RGB uint16 NHWC.
notes.input_quantization: q = round(normalized / input_scale) + 32768, with input_scale = 3.05180438e-05 and input zero_point 32768. The aligned crop is 112x112 RGB.
notes.embedding: 512-D embedding; L2 normalization and model-version binding are the embedding decoder's responsibility. This is not a matching decision.
notes.offline_path: For offline JPEG/PNG input the documented path is BGR/RGB image -> RGB -> letterbox 640x640 -> float normalization -> quantize to uint16 by scale/zero_point.
